counting_note: Automated filesystem reconciliation. Unique item counts deduplicate by AID, then source URL, then ID. promotion_ready_records excludes stale staging queue flags whose stable item key already exists in canonical. Evidence-family files are counted separately.
content_readiness_note: Unique sources are Evidence Families; distinct inspected propositions are aggregated across their member items. Bibliographic verification and editorial summaries do not count.
